name: The Obey
source: While trying to survive in a destitute world, you fall into slavery to the insidious Madame Madlen. Will you be able to break free or will you accept your fate? The choice is yours.
translation: While trying to survive in a destitute world, you fall into slavery to the insidious Madame Madlen. Will you be able to break free or will you accept your fate? The choice is yours.
